findingTitle: No wallet declared — the only address on the page is a CONTRACT
findingDetail: Vette read BaseScout's site looking for a wallet. The only address published is a token contract (the AERO contract). A contract found in site copy is not an auditable wallet, so no wallet verdict is issued — the disclosure miss itself is the finding.
note: Verdict: UNVERIFIABLE. Vette will not score a wallet that was never declared. Re-run it yourself — paste the site in the hero — and watch the engine refuse to invent a wallet.
